bull_bear.body:
- Our Adjusted Free Cash Flow, which represents the operational cash generation of our business and is arrived at by adding IPO prepayments, proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and reducing purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and expenditure incurred on intangible asset under development to net cash flows used in operating activities, was ₹(556.64) million in Financial Year 2024, ₹(348.33) million in Financial Year 2025 and ₹108.17 million in Financial Year 2026.
- Our efforts to acquire new users, clients and customers of our business and retain them may not be successful or may be more costly than we expect, which could prevent us from maintaining or increasing our revenue.
- Focusing on catering to the demand arising from users in Tier 2+ cities of India, please see details of the delivered units purchased by customers in Tier 2+ cities of India for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities (million) (A) 16.95 13.22 9.85 Delivered units (million) (B) 25.98 19.91 14.81 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities as a percentage of delivered units (%) (C=A/B) 65.24% 66.37% 66.48% We also typically incur significant marketing and business promotion expenses – marketplace to promote our Snapdeal platform.
- Set out below are the number of annual transacting customers for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Number of Annual Transacting Customers(1) (in millions) 12.16(2) 10.43(2) 7.85 (1) Annual transacting customers refers to number of customers, identified by their unique mobile number, to whom at least one unit has been shipped during the last twelve months period preceding the end of the reporting year (2) We focused on growing the scale of our business during Financial Year 2025 and Financial Year 2026 4.
- Retailers and e-commerce platforms have carved out unique positions based on customer needs, product categories, pricing bands, and fulfilment strategies. (Source: 1Lattice Report) We also compete with various e-commerce platforms on which sellers can list their products, as well as physical stores operating in the same segment as ours, and the unorganised sector.
- Further, many current or prospective clients may find competing products more attractive if we do not keep pace with market innovation and may choose or switch to competing products even if we do our best to innovate and provide superior products.
- If we fail to develop and innovate our technology-based expertise in a timely and effective manner, our brand, competitive edge and market share may lose or may face resistance from our existing or potential client.
- Between Financial Year 2024 and Financial Year 2025, our Company shifted the strategic focus towards scaling the business and implemented pricing changes to lower the cost of doing business for sellers, enabling them to offer competitive pricing to customers.

risks: Our Adjusted Free Cash Flow, which represents the operational cash generation of our business and is arrived at by adding IPO prepayments, proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and reducing purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and expenditure incurred on intangible asset under development to net cash flows used in operating activities, was ₹(556.64) million in Financial Year 2024, ₹(348.33) million in Financial Year 2025 and ₹108.17 million in Financial Year 2026.

Our efforts to acquire new users, clients and customers of our business and retain them may not be successful or may be more costly than we expect, which could prevent us from maintaining or increasing our revenue.

Focusing on catering to the demand arising from users in Tier 2+ cities of India, please see details of the delivered units purchased by customers in Tier 2+ cities of India for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities (million) (A) 16.95 13.22 9.85 Delivered units (million) (B) 25.98 19.91 14.81 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities as a percentage of delivered units (%) (C=A/B) 65.24% 66.37% 66.48% We also typically incur significant marketing and business promotion expenses – marketplace to promote our Snapdeal platform.

Set out below are the number of annual transacting customers for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Number of Annual Transacting Customers(1) (in millions) 12.16(2) 10.43(2) 7.85 (1) Annual transacting customers refers to number of customers, identified by their unique mobile number, to whom at least one unit has been shipped during the last twelve months period preceding the end of the reporting year (2) We focused on growing the scale of our business during Financial Year 2025 and Financial Year 2026 4.

Retailers and e-commerce platforms have carved out unique positions based on customer needs, product categories, pricing bands, and fulfilment strategies. (Source: 1Lattice Report) We also compete with various e-commerce platforms on which sellers can list their products, as well as physical stores operating in the same segment as ours, and the unorganised sector.

Further, many current or prospective clients may find competing products more attractive if we do not keep pace with market innovation and may choose or switch to competing products even if we do our best to innovate and provide superior products.

If we fail to develop and innovate our technology-based expertise in a timely and effective manner, our brand, competitive edge and market share may lose or may face resistance from our existing or potential client.

Between Financial Year 2024 and Financial Year 2025, our Company shifted the strategic focus towards scaling the business and implemented pricing changes to lower the cost of doing business for sellers, enabling them to offer competitive pricing to customers.

strategy_growth.risk: We operate in a highly competitive industry and our failure to compete effectively could have a negative impact on the success of our business and/or impact our margins Our market is highly competitive and characterised by rapid changes in technology and consumer sentiment.

Since we started our Snapdeal platform in 2010, we have evolved from a coupon booklet business to a digital commerce ecosystem consisting of a triple engine of data-driven technology businesses of (i) Snapdeal: a value- focused lifestyle e-commerce marketplace platform, (ii) Unicommerce: a comprehensive suite of e-commerce enablement SaaS products and (iii) Stellaro Brands: omnichannel value-focused consumer brands business.

Our technology infrastructure and the technology infrastructure of our third-party providers (including our cloud infrastructure service providers) are susceptible to security breaches and cyber-attacks.

moat.title: Bull — competitive strengths
moat.body:
- Diversified ecosystem driving organic and inorganic growth across businesses with centralised strategy support, shared capabilities, and financial efficiency
- Collectively, our businesses process and utilise a large amount of e-commerce data which can be utilised for creating extensive AI-led use-cases
- Leading value-focused e-commerce marketplace purpose  built for value shoppers, offering a wide range of high quality lifestyle products

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- Our Adjusted Free Cash Flow, which represents the operational cash generation of our business and is arrived at by adding IPO prepayments, proceeds from sale of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and reducing purchase of property, plant and equipment and intangible assets and expenditure incurred on intangible asset under development to net cash flows used in operating activities, was ₹(556.64) million in Financial Year 2024, ₹(348.33) million in Financial Year 2025 and ₹108.17 million in Financial Year 2026.
- Our efforts to acquire new users, clients and customers of our business and retain them may not be successful or may be more costly than we expect, which could prevent us from maintaining or increasing our revenue.
- Focusing on catering to the demand arising from users in Tier 2+ cities of India, please see details of the delivered units purchased by customers in Tier 2+ cities of India for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities (million) (A) 16.95 13.22 9.85 Delivered units (million) (B) 25.98 19.91 14.81 Delivered units from users in Tier 2+ cities as a percentage of delivered units (%) (C=A/B) 65.24% 66.37% 66.48% We also typically incur significant marketing and business promotion expenses – marketplace to promote our Snapdeal platform.
- Set out below are the number of annual transacting customers for Financial Years 2026, 2025 and 2024: Particulars For the Financial Year ended March 31, 2026 March 31, 2025 March 31, 2024 Number of Annual Transacting Customers(1) (in millions) 12.16(2) 10.43(2) 7.85 (1) Annual transacting customers refers to number of customers, identified by their unique mobile number, to whom at least one unit has been shipped during the last twelve months period preceding the end of the reporting year (2) We focused on growing the scale of our business during Financial Year 2025 and Financial Year 2026 4.
- Retailers and e-commerce platforms have carved out unique positions based on customer needs, product categories, pricing bands, and fulfilment strategies. (Source: 1Lattice Report) We also compete with various e-commerce platforms on which sellers can list their products, as well as physical stores operating in the same segment as ours, and the unorganised sector.
- Further, many current or prospective clients may find competing products more attractive if we do not keep pace with market innovation and may choose or switch to competing products even if we do our best to innovate and provide superior products.
- If we fail to develop and innovate our technology-based expertise in a timely and effective manner, our brand, competitive edge and market share may lose or may face resistance from our existing or potential client.
- Between Financial Year 2024 and Financial Year 2025, our Company shifted the strategic focus towards scaling the business and implemented pricing changes to lower the cost of doing business for sellers, enabling them to offer competitive pricing to customers.
